summary: To delete a block rule, install ansible_security.acl_manager and run a playbook on the checkpoint hosts (connection httpapi) that includes acl_manager with tasks_from unblock_ip and the source_ip, destination_ip and ansible_network_os: checkpoint vars, using ansible-navigator run --ee false; then confirm on the MGMT server that the policy was removed.
questions: How do I unblock an IP with acl_manager?
How do I delete a firewall rule with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Unblock an IP (delete a rule) with acl_manager
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: delete block list entry
  hosts: checkpoint
  connection: httpapi
  tasks:
    - include_role:
        name: acl_manager
        tasks_from: unblock_ip
      vars:
        source_ip: 192.168.0.10
        destination_ip: 192.168.0.11
        ansible_network_os: checkpoint
```
Run with `ansible-navigator run --ee false <playbook.yml>`, then check on the MGMT server that the policy is gone. (The doc's sample omits the `tasks:` key; add it.)
